failure_summary.description: Agent did not retrieve relevant seeds (Hit@10=0); skill did not force the exact hybrid seed call with limit=10 and explicit BM25+dense hybrid configuration.
Agent continued or returned unusable results instead of performing one concise hybrid reformulation then abstaining (NOT FOUND) when evidence remained missing.

patch.reasoning: Both failures stem from under-specified retrieval and recovery steps in the Strategy and Failure recovery sections. Making the required hybrid seed call explicit (tool name, hybrid mode, limit param) prevents silent missed retrievals. Strengthening the recovery policy (one hybrid reformulation, verify fetched passages, then abstain with NOT FOUND when evidence is insufficient) stops the agent from producing unsupported answers or continuing futile graph traversal.

edits.target: 2. Request `limit: 10` from BM25+dense seed retrieval so the evidence package matches the benchmark's Recall/Hit/nDCG@10 contract. Do not perform unbounded or graph-only exploration.
edits.content: 2. Always begin retrieval with an explicit hybrid BM25+dense seed request using the techdocs_search tool and include the parameter `limit: 10` (e.g., techdocs_search(query=..., mode="bm25+dense", limit=10)). This ensures the seed set matches the benchmark Recall/Hit/nDCG@10 contract. Do not perform unbounded graph-only exploration before obtaining this seed set. If the initial seed set is empty or clearly off-topic, perform at most one concise hybrid reformulation of the search (adjusting query phrasing or filters) and re-run techdocs_search(limit=10). Do not perform multiple reformulations or unbounded expansions.

- If a bounded expansion (techdocs_expand) is used, fetch and verify every graph-added target with techdocs_fetch before using it as evidence. If verification shows the neighbor does not support the inferred relationship, reject that neighbor and return to the strongest remaining seed.
 - If, after the bounded expansion and the single allowed hybrid reformulation, the required evidence is still missing or unverifiable, abstain and return NOT FOUND rather than producing unsupported claims. When abstaining in the evaluation format, return the exact JSON: {"answer":"NOT FOUND","sources":[]}. This explicit abstention prevents guesses when the retrieval contract fails.
